note: Resolved per-room sensors, the floor/household and power aggregates derived from them, the climate health-risk binary sensor, and the roll-ups Home's Needs attention reads. Reference only; entity ids are anonymised. Exported by tests/dashboards/export.py. 2026-10-07: 'Lighting daylight' (on = bright enough, no lights) is the dark entity Magic Areas reads before switching a room's lights on; the bathroom's and shower's readings are Magic Areas aggregates (one sensor each, lint C20), not template sensors. 2026-10-09: 'Any safety alarm' rolls up every leak/smoke/gas/CO/safety binary sensor in the house for Home's Needs attention; it excludes itself so it cannot latch. 2026-10-12: 'Any low battery' lists every battery under 20 % that a person replaces (phones, the car and vacuums are skipped; by entity id since 2026-10-20, so Home can make each one a tile), 'Lighting left on' the lights still on; both say 'none' when there is nothing to say. 2026-10-14: 'Any safety sensor silent' names a safety sensor unavailable for 30 minutes. 2026-10-20: 'Lighting living room bright', 'Lighting kitchen dark' and 'Lighting hallway bright' are the dark entities Magic Areas reads for the open space and the hallway: the room's own lux in real time, with outdoor daylight only as the fallback (docs/presence-lighting.md). 2026-10-20: 'Any low battery' is the ONE battery list; the binary 'Any battery low' and the Home card's own copy (15 %, a volvo substring skip) are gone (lint C29). 'Lighting night' is the helper dashboards read for night; the automations keep their own copy of the same expression (tests/climate/harness.py NIGHT_CONSUMERS).
